stance_rationale: PD20-A Path 1 is diagnostic-grade, not approval-grade: the primary package is still a draft with TBD fields, canonical mailbox weights.csv is absent, and official bt_result cost/turnover/ticker holdings are placeholders. The realized Path 1 evidence also shows severe MDD/CVaR degradation and lacks same-cost same-DSR Harvey 5-spec validation for the composite.

dsr_penalty_audit.candidate_count_basis: inferred lower bound: PD18 M=18 plus PD20-A Path 1 additional forge variant

critical_concerns.description: The critique target is still a draft package: expected metrics and md5 fields are TBD, draft_finalization_pending_build=true, and the requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260511_001 directory plus mailbox weights.csv are absent. Stage artifacts exist under stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001, but the stage weights.csv is a 155-date high_20pct schedule ending 2023-11, not the PD20-A Path 1 184-date 10% NEW schedule.

Walk-forward evidence is not contract-clean at ticker level. holdings.csv has Date=ALL sleeve placeholders, not per-date tickers; period_returns.csv has turnover=0 and cost_ret=0 for all 255 months; liquidity, max_names, per-security cap, actual turnover, and cost compliance are deferred rather than proven.

Path 1 fixes the production 20-name count but materially worsens risk: primary MDD is -28.07% versus PD18 -11.54% and S4 -12.52%, cost-embedded MDD is -30.29%, CVaR_95 is -6.70% versus PD18 -4.42%, and the 4-axis check is only 2_PASS_2_FAIL. Cap compliance cannot rationalize a worse drawdown/tail profile.

Same-period baseline exists, but same-cost and same-DSR parity do not. Path 1 has only a uniform 23.5bps/month cost assumption, no same-cost baseline recompute, no Path 1 DSR, and no composite CAPM/Carhart-3/Carhart-4/FF5/FF6 Harvey regression set.

The OOS/lockbox evidence is operational refresh, not sealed lockbox validation: oos_zoom_chart explicitly says NOT sealed lockbox OOS, the equity chart has no red dashed lockbox marker, and no frozen buy-and-hold extension is applied.

The cost implementation is an assumption outside the official bt_result: the code uses 15bps x2 in a diagnostic cost variant, but nav.csv cum_cost remains 0 and period_returns cost_ret remains 0. Turnover <600% annual is therefore not proven from realized ticker trades.

Downstream Forge evidence still inherits alpha PIT-C13/C14 accepted-timeline status. alpha_scores.parquet is a valid 184-date time-series artifact, but the Z_Score_Aligned-only rebuild and Usable_Date audit are not resolved in the target evidence chain.

supporting_arguments: Pure-function RDS audit passes: alpha/risk/optimization package md5s match pre/post.
alpha_scores.parquet is time-series, not single snapshot: 62916 rows, 184 sig_dates from 2011-01-01 to 2026-04-01, 770 tickers.
covariance.parquet is PSD and condition-clean: min eigenvalue 0.01217143, condition number 8.812 <= 100.
Path 1 backtest artifacts cover 255 months from 2005-02 to 2026-04, and required chart files exist.
unresolved_disputes: Whether the missing canonical mailbox weights.csv can be replaced by noncanonical stage artifacts with a different high_20pct method and shorter date range.
Whether Path 1 can be treated as a viable production fix when it worsens MDD by 16.53pp versus PD18.
Whether a uniform cost assumption can satisfy the 15bps mandate without realized ticker-level turnover.
Whether operational alpha refresh can substitute for Pre-LB / Lockbox / Combined reporting.
Whether AX-008 can count this Forge path as PASS before composite DSR and 5-spec Harvey tests are produced.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest claim is that sleeve-weighted top-N truncation (1715 top16 + NEW top4) solves the production 20-name constraint without creating an admission-blocking risk and evidence-quality problem.
rebuttal_required: Finalize forge_package_path1_sleeve_top_n with actual metrics, md5 audit values, and no TBD fields.
Publish a canonical PD20-A Path 1 weights.csv and full ticker-level holdings for every rebalance date.
Recompute official period_returns/nav with realized turnover and 15bps one-way costs.
Run same-period same-cost same-DSR baseline and candidate tests with a documented M count.
Produce composite-level CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 Newey-West t-stats.
Provide formal Pre-LB / Lockbox / Combined segregation or a signed role-card amendment.
rationalization_red_flags: TC drag ... negligible vs delta SR

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The artifacts are useful diagnostics, but they are not a clean independent Forge PASS source because canonical schedule, cost/turnover, ticker holdings, DSR, 5-spec regression, and sealed lockbox separation remain unresolved.

forge_specific_questions: Pure Function v6.1 R12 hash audit이 PRE=POST 모두 일치하는가? Artifact RDS says yes, but the target draft package still has TBD fields.
walk-forward 시계열 충분 (>=60 sig_dates)이고 single-snapshot 위험 없는가? Alpha scores are 184-date time series, but canonical weights.csv is absent and holdings are sleeve placeholders.
Lockbox period strategy NAV가 equity_curve에 visible한가? The line extends through 2026, but no lockbox marker or frozen extension evidence is present.
baseline 비교가 same-period · same-cost · same-DSR-penalty인가? Same-period yes; same-cost and same-DSR no.
